Welcome—I'm glad you're here. Have you ever wondered why the things you expect to make you happy sometimes fall short, while unexpected moments end up leaving the biggest smiles? Together, we're about to step into a world where intuition, memory, and imagination—those familiar tools we use to chase happiness—might actually be leading us off course.
Inspired by Daniel Todd Gilbert’s Stumbling on Happiness, we'll explore the fascinating quirks of how our minds predict what will make us happy... and why we so often get it wrong. We'll dig into how perception, memory, and expectation shape not just our choices, but our whole sense of fulfillment. And along the way, you'll see how even our best guesses about the future are packed with hidden biases and blind spots.
Through a mix of science, stories, and a bit of humor, we'll challenge old assumptions and look at the mind’s clever, sometimes sneaky, tricks. Imagine discovering that true contentment isn’t about perfectly predicting what’s next, but about embracing the twists and turns in life’s emotional journey.
So, if you're ready to rethink what happiness really means—and maybe stumble onto some new insights—let's explore this together.
